title: Single-strand Library Preparation Protocol
author: Tomasz Suchan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.q5ydy7w

steps.title: Prepare Master Mixes
steps.instruction: Prepare the following master mixes as specified:

substeps.instruction: Master Mix 1: 1.3 µL (undetermined reagent), 0.7 µL NEBuffer 4 (10x), 1 µL water, and FAST alkaline phosphatase (1 U/μl).
Master Mix 2 (assemble at room temperature): water 0.7 µL, NEBuffer 4 (10x), CoCl2 (2.5 mM), GTP (100 mM), and TdT (20 U/μl).
Master Mix 3: water, NEBuffer 4 (10x), dNTP mix (25 mM each), P2-CCCCC oligo (15 mM) 2 µL, and Klenow exo- (5 U/μl).
Master Mix 4: water, NEBuffer 4 (10x), BSA (10 mg/ml), and T4 DNA polymerase (3 U/μl).
Master Mix 5: water, PEG-4000 (50%), T4 ligase buffer (10x), and T4 DNA ligase (400 U/μl).
Prepare a second version of Master Mix 4 (for PCR): water, Q5 polymerase buffer (5x), dNTP mix (25 mM each), and Q5 hot-start polymerase.

steps.title: Prepare Barcoded P1 Adapters
steps.instruction: Prepare barcoded P1 adapters at a 25 μM concentration. Mix each sample with a different adapter if barcoding is required.

steps.title: Dephosphorylation and TdT Treatment
steps.instruction: Process the DNA through initial enzymatic treatments:

substeps.instruction: Add 3 μl of master mix 1 to 10 μl of DNA (total volume = 13 μl).
Add 7 μl of master mix 2 to the denatured DNA (total volume = 20 μl).
Incubate for 30 min at 37°C.
Heat-kill the enzymes for 10 min at 70°C and spin down.

steps.title: Klenow Extension
steps.instruction: Extend the DNA using Master Mix 3:

substeps.instruction: Add 10 μl of master mix 3 to 20 μl of the DNA (total volume = 30 μl).
Incubate at room temperature for 3 hours.
Heat-kill enzymes for 20 min at 75°C and spin down.
Keep both DNA and the mix on ice during assembly.
Add 5 μl of master mix 4 to 30 μl of the DNA (total volume = 35 μl).
Incubate for 15 min at 12°C.
Hold at 4°C and proceed immediately to the next step.

steps.title: First AMPure Cleanup
steps.instruction: Purify the reaction using AMPure beads:

substeps.instruction: Perform cleanup with a beads:sample ratio of 2:1 (70 μl beads and 35 μl reaction) per manufacturer's instructions.
Resuspend the resulting pellet in 11 μl of 10 mM Tris or water.

steps.title: Adapter Ligation
steps.instruction: Ligate the barcoded adapters to the DNA:

substeps.instruction: Add 1 μl of the adapter (25 μM working solution) to 10 μl of the DNA; briefly vortex and spin.
Add 9 μl of master mix 5 to each sample (total volume = 20 μl).
Incubate at 16°C for 3 hours and spin down.

steps.title: Second AMPure Cleanup
steps.instruction: Purify the ligated DNA using AMPure beads:

substeps.instruction: Perform cleanup with a beads:sample ratio of 1:1 (20 μl beads and 20 μl reaction) per manufacturer's instructions.
Resuspend in 11 μl of 10 mM Tris or water.
Transfer 10 μl of the purified DNA to plates/tubes.
Add 35 μl of the PCR master mix (Master Mix 4/3 variant) to each tube/well.
Add 2.5 μl of each primer (5 μM working solutions) and 10 μl of the template.
Run the following PCR program: 30 s at 98°C; 15 cycles of (10 s at 98°C, 20 s at 60°C, 25 s at 72°C); 5 min at 72°C; hold at 4°C. (Note: Determine required cycle number experimentally).

steps.title: Quality Control and Final Processing
steps.instruction: Verify the library and perform final denaturation:

substeps.instruction: Check the reaction on a gel or Tapestation/Fragment Analyzer.
Quantify the DNA using a Qubit fluorimeter.
Incubate for 1 h at 37°C.
Denature the DNA for 5 min at 95°C and move the sample immediately to ice (prepare ice at the end of the 37°C incubation).
